reviews_captured_by_me.text: Jason and crew did a great job on our Kala Point bathroom remodel. Fair price -- nothing in remodeling is cheap these days. Quality work, good suggestions and pleasant to work with. Good communication.

Jason was selected by our general contractor during a bathroom remodel and we couldn't be more pleased. He was very professional, asked all the right questions, hand selected the tile that we bought, did an amazing job with the install and had design ideas that made the bathroom even better than we had hoped.  He and his assistant Max worked hard to keep the rest of the house clean and did a great job cleaning up after themselves when they were done. Jason communicated very well with us about scheduling, material selections, installation, the design, and answered lots of questions from us. I would highly recommend Jason for any tile job!

Jason did an excellent job on installing wall and floor tile in two bathrooms.  He also took on a challenging job of putting down random slate pieces in our foyer that came out beautifully.  I recommend him without hesitation.
